name: Simple Profit By Periods Panel 2 Extended
summary: This is a panel/dashboard utility that displays profit and loss statistics broken down by different time periods (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.). It provides an extended version with additional features for monitoring trading account performance across multiple timeframes, helping traders evaluate their strategy effectiveness over various periods.
summary_zh: 这是一个面板/仪表板工具，按不同时间段（日、周、月等）分类显示盈亏统计信息。它是扩展版本，提供了更多功能来监控交易账户在不同时间周期内的表现，帮助交易者评估其策略在各个周期内的有效性。
strategy_analysis: 此EA不是一个自动交易策略，而是一个账户盈亏监控面板工具。它的核心功能是按时间段（如今天、昨天、本周、上周、本月、上月、今年等）统计和显示账户的盈亏数据。入场条件不适用，因为它不会自动开仓交易。出场条件同样不适用。仓位管理不适用，该工具不涉及任何仓位操作。资金管理方面，它仅作为信息展示工具，帮助交易者了解各时间段的盈亏状况，从而做出更好的资金管理决策。扩展版本可能包含更详细的统计指标、可自定义的时间段、图形化展示以及交易历史分析功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an automated trading strategy but rather an account profit/loss monitoring panel utility. Its core function is to calculate and display account profit and loss data broken down by different time periods (such as today, yesterday, this week, last week, this month, last month, this year, etc.). Entry conditions are not applicable since it does not open trades automatically. Exit conditions are likewise not applicable. Position sizing is not relevant as the tool does not involve any position management. In terms of money management, it serves purely as an information display tool, helping traders understand their profit and loss across various periods to make better money management decisions. The extended version likely includes more detailed statistical metrics, customizable time periods, graphical displays, and trade history analysis features.
pros: 提供多时间段的盈亏统计视图，帮助交易者全面了解账户表现
扩展版本功能更丰富，可能包含更多自定义选项和统计指标
作为信息展示工具不涉及交易操作，不会对账户造成风险
可视化面板便于快速查看，无需手动计算各周期盈亏
有助于交易者识别自身交易在不同时间段的表现规律
pros_en: Provides multi-period profit/loss statistics view, helping traders comprehensively understand account performance
Extended version offers richer features, likely including more customization options and statistical metrics
As an information display tool, it does not involve trading operations and poses no risk to the account
Visual panel enables quick overview without manual calculation of periodic profit and loss
Helps traders identify their trading performance patterns across different time periods
cons: 仅作为显示工具，不提供交易信号或自动交易功能
面板可能占用图表空间，影响其他指标或交易的视觉布局
无法直接与交易操作联动，如根据盈亏自动调整仓位
依赖交易历史数据的准确性，数据缺失时统计可能不准确
扩展版本可能增加图表资源消耗，在多个图表上运行时影响性能
cons_en: Functions only as a display tool, does not provide trading signals or automated trading capabilities
Panel may occupy chart space, affecting the visual layout of other indicators or trading activities
Cannot directly integrate with trading operations, such as automatically adjusting positions based on profit/loss
Relies on accuracy of trade history data; statistics may be inaccurate when data is missing
Extended version may increase chart resource consumption, affecting performance when running on multiple charts
improvements: 增加根据盈亏统计自动调整仓位或发出警告的功能
添加导出盈亏报告为CSV或PDF的功能，便于离线分析
improvements_en: Add functionality to automatically adjust positions or issue warnings based on profit/loss statistics
Add feature to export profit/loss reports as CSV or PDF for offline analysis

risk_points: 面板显示依赖正确的时间计算，时区设置不当可能导致统计偏差
如果面板资源管理不当，可能在大量交易历史时导致图表卡顿
risk_points_en: Panel display relies on correct time calculation; improper timezone settings may cause statistical deviation
If panel resource management is inadequate, it may cause chart lag with large trade history

summary_en: This is a panel/dashboard utility that displays profit and loss statistics broken down by different time periods (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.). It provides an extended version with additional features for monitoring trading account performance across multiple timeframes, helping traders evaluate their strategy effectiveness over various periods.
